name: B2·4 Festive Engine + UGC Collector — auto campaign kickoff + customer-content saver (2 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Variables: **GEMINI_API_KEY, TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, BRAND_NAME**. Attach Telegram + Sheets + Google Drive credentials.
2. Tab **Festivals** in your sheet: Name, Date (YYYY-MM-DD), Major (yes/no). Paste from the Suite's Calendar CSV export.
3. Drive: create folder 'UGC' → copy its folder ID into the Drive node.
4. UGC intake: Activate → copy the `ugc-in` webhook Production URL → give customers a QR/link to a small form (name, phone, photo upload) OR wire ManyChat 'story-mention' to POST here.

## HOW IT RUNS
• Daily 08:30 — if any festival is exactly 14 days away → Gemini generates the full campaign brief (teaser/push/reminder posts, WhatsApp broadcast text, offer idea) → Telegram. You get a ready campaign 2 weeks early, every time.
• UGC webhook — photo saved to Drive, logged, owner alerted, and a thank-you + permission request text is prepared.

## 🔧 FIX
• No campaign brief → check Festivals dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
• Drive upload fails → re-share folder with connected account.
• Binary missing → the form must POST multipart with the file field named 'photo'.
